---
title: "Penguins_linear_reg"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(bayesrules)
library(rstanarm)
library(report)
library(ggpubr)

data <- bayesrules::penguins_bayes
```

## Histogram

```{r}

ggplot(data, aes(x = flipper_length_mm))+
  geom_histogram(fill = "darkolivegreen", color = "black")+
  theme_bw()

```

## Scatterplot

```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(y = flipper_length_mm, x = bill_length_mm))+
  geom_point(color = "darkolivegreen")+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")+ 
  stat_cor()
```

```{r}
library(ggExtra)

sctr <- ggplot(data, aes(y = flipper_length_mm, x = bill_length_mm))+
  geom_point(color = "darkolivegreen")+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")+ 
  stat_cor()

sctr_f <- ggMarginal(sctr, type= "density")

print(sctr_f)
```

```{r}
m0 <- 200 
s0 <- 10.2
m1 <- 3.5
s1 <- 1.02
l <- 0.08


model <- stan_glm(
  flipper_length_mm ~ bill_length_mm, data = data,
  family = gaussian,
  prior_intercept = normal(m0, s0),
  prior = normal(m1, s1),
  prior_aux = exponential(l),
  chains = 4, iter = 2000, seed = 84735
)
```

```{r}
posterior <- as.data.frame(model)
beta0c_draws <- posterior$`(Intercept)` + posterior$bill_length
```

```{r}
report::report(model)
```
